description: This file defines the ListScreen component for a React Native notes app, including subcomponents and hooks for displaying, searching, and navigating notes.

methods.name: ListItem
methods.description: A functional component rendering individual note summaries with title, snippet, and last updated time.

methods.name: load
methods.description: An async callback function that fetches notes based on the search query and updates state.

methods.name: onRefresh
methods.description: Triggers a reload of notes when the user performs a pull-to-refresh gesture.
